description: Black-and-white historical photograph of a mass outdoor rally in a German-speaking city square, likely early 1930s. A dense crowd fills the square before a stage, with spectators packed onto grandstands and balconies of surrounding multi-story buildings. Banners in German promote Antifaschistische Aktion (Antifascist Action), including one reading 'Das Abzeichen des Antifaschisten' (the badge of the antifascist) and a flag bearing the movement's two-flags emblem. Exact city, venue and date are not shown in the image.
text: ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. DAS ABZEICHEN DES ANTIFASCHISTEN.
flags: Location and date inferred from language and style, not shown in the image; some banner text partially illegible

description: Close-up photograph of a round black PVC morale patch lying on granite. It bears a white Punisher-style skull with red eyes and the motto 'God will judge our enemies / We'll arrange the meeting' in white capital letters around the rim, flanked by two stars. The archive filename associates the patch with SEAL Team 6; the slogan is popularly linked to U.S. special-operations culture, but no unit marking is visible on the patch itself.
text: GOD WILL JUDGE OUR ENEMIES. WE'LL ARRANGE THE MEETING.
flags: SEAL Team 6 association comes from the filename, not from any visible unit insignia
